trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Request cashless approval and provide initial details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నాకు ఒక procedure కోసం cashless approval కావాలి. ఇది నా మొదటి సారి, policy కొత్తది. నా patient ID PT-2003. నా పేరు నరేష్.
నమస్కారం, నాకు ఒక procedure కోసం cashless approval కావాలి. ఇది నా మొదటి సారి, policy కొత్తది. నా patient ID PT-2003. నా పేరు నరేష్.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the patient ID and name provided.
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing policy details, identity must be verified using the name provided by the user.

steps.purpose: Return verification failure due to STT error on the name.
Explain the verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the failure without inventing a cause, and ask for a different verification factor.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, మీ పేరు మా రికార్డ్స్ తో మ్యాచ్ అవ్వలేదు. దయచేసి verification కోసం మీ registered pincode లేదా date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Recognize the verification failure and ask for an alternative factor to recover the workflow.

steps.purpose: Provide alternative verification factor and express anxiety.
steps.text: అవునా? నా date of birth 15th August 1985. నా policy number POL-55503. ఏమైనా problem ఉందా అండి?

steps.purpose: Verify identity using the newly provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity again with the new factor.
steps.planner_rationale: Attempt identity verification again using the date of birth provided by the user.

steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_policy_coverage since identity is now verified.
steps.planner_rationale: Retrieve policy details to check balance and waiting period status.

steps.purpose: Return policy details showing an active waiting period.
Reassure the user and explain that the waiting period blocks cashless.
steps.expected_behavior: State the balance accurately and explain that the active waiting period prevents cashless authorization.
steps.text: Verification పూర్తయింది, భయపడకండి. మీ StarHealth policy లో 400000 రూపాయల balance ఉంది, కానీ policy కొత్తది కాబట్టి waiting period active లో ఉంది. Waiting period లో ఉన్నప్పుడు cashless approval కుదరదు.
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the tool output, stating the balance and explaining that the active waiting period blocks cashless authorization.

steps.purpose: Ask for an estimate for a general room and confirm reimbursement possibility.
steps.text: Cashless కుదరదా? సరే, నేను సొంతంగా pay చేస్తే reimbursement వస్తుందా? డాక్టర్ గారు general room లో appendix surgery కి వెళ్ళమన్నారు, ఒకసారి estimate చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Get the cost estimate for the procedure in a general room.
steps.expected_behavior: Call estimate_procedure_cost for the requested procedure and room category.
steps.planner_rationale: Fetch the package estimate for the general room as requested by the user.

steps.purpose: Return the estimate for a general room.
Provide the general room estimate and confirm reimbursement.
steps.expected_behavior: State the package estimate and room rent exactly as returned, and confirm reimbursement is an alternative.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు బిల్స్ submit చేసి reimbursement కి apply చేసుకోవచ్చు. General room లో appendix surgery కి package estimate 45000 రూపాయలు అవుతుంది. Room rent రోజుకి 3000 ఉంటుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the estimate for the general room exactly as returned by the tool, and confirm reimbursement is an option.

steps.purpose: Restate the figure and ask for a semi-private room estimate against the policy limit.
steps.text: అంటే మొత్తం 45000 రూపాయలు అవుతుంది కదా. ఒకవేళ నేను semi_private room తీసుకుంటే ఎంత అవుతుంది? నా policy లో room rent limit ఎంతుందో చూసి చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Get the cost estimate for a semi-private room.
steps.expected_behavior: Call estimate_procedure_cost for the semi-private room category.
steps.planner_rationale: Fetch the package estimate for the semi-private room to compare against the room rent cap.

steps.purpose: Return the estimate for a semi-private room.
Provide the semi-private room estimate and confirm it is within the room rent cap.
steps.expected_behavior: State the room rent cap from the earlier lookup and the new estimate, ensuring all figures match the tool results.
steps.text: మీ policy లో room rent cap రోజుకి 5000 రూపాయలు ఉందండి. Semi_private room కి package estimate 60000 రూపాయలు అవుతుంది, మరియు room rent రోజుకి సరిగ్గా 5000 ఉంటుంది. కాబట్టి ఇది మీ limit లోనే ఉంది.
steps.planner_rationale: State the room rent cap from the earlier policy lookup and the new estimate for the semi-private room, ensuring all figures are grounded.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.
